*I’d fix two issues before merging.*

1. *[P2] Extension parsing violates the documented behavior* — `src/extension.js:2`
   It takes the text after the *first* dot and doesn’t lowercase it.
   - `report.pdf.jpg` → `application/pdf`, instead of `image/jpeg`
   - `photo.JPG` → `application/octet-stream`, instead of `image/jpeg`
   - Extensionless names return `undefined`, rather than the documented `''`.

   Extract after the last dot, lowercase it, and return `''` when there’s no extension.

2. *[P2] Inherited object properties bypass the MIME fallback* — `src/content-type.js:11`
   `TYPES` is a normal object, so unknown extensions can resolve to prototype properties. Confirmed: `file.constructor` returns a function and `file.__proto__` returns an object instead of `application/octet-stream`. Use an own-property check, a null-prototype dictionary, or a `Map`.

All 3 existing tests pass, but they don’t cover these cases or test `contentType` directly. Add regression coverage for multi-dot names, uppercase extensions, missing/trailing extensions, and prototype-property names.

Reviewed `main…upload-extensions` at `a34d0a4`. No files changed.
